title: Detailed football
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='ballGrad' cx='38%' cy='32%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffdf5'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#f0e6c8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d4c49a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='patchGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5a4a8a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a2a5a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shadowGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c4b48a' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c4b48a' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Ball shadow underneath -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='30' ry='7' fill='#5a4a8a' opacity='0.25'/>

  <!-- Main ball circle -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='36' fill='url(#ballGrad)'/>

  <!-- Subtle shading on bottom right -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='36' fill='url(#shadowGrad)' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- Pentagon patches -->
  <!-- Center pentagon -->
  <polygon points='50,30 60,37 56,48 44,48 40,37' fill='url(#patchGrad)' stroke='#4a3a7a' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- Top pentagon -->
  <polygon points='50,14 58,19 56,27 44,27 42,19' fill='url(#patchGrad)' stroke='#4a3a7a' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- Bottom pentagon -->
  <polygon points='50,62 58,67 56,75 44,75 42,67' fill='url(#patchGrad)' stroke='#4a3a7a' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- Left pentagon -->
  <polygon points='22,44 30,39 36,46 32,54 24,54' fill='url(#patchGrad)' stroke='#4a3a7a' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- Right pentagon -->
  <polygon points='78,44 70,39 64,46 68,54 76,54' fill='url(#patchGrad)' stroke='#4a3a7a' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- Center pentagon highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,32 58,38 55,46 45,46 42,38' fill='#7a6aaa' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- Seam lines connecting pentagons -->
  <g stroke='#b8a87a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.7'>
    <!-- Top center to top pentagon -->
    <line x1='50' y1='30' x2='50' y2='27'/>
    <!-- Center to bottom -->
    <line x1='50' y1='48' x2='50' y2='62'/>
    <!-- Center to left -->
    <line x1='40' y1='42' x2='36' y2='46'/>
    <!-- Center to right -->
    <line x1='60' y1='42' x2='64' y2='46'/>
    <!-- Top pentagon to left pentagon -->
    <line x1='44' y1='27' x2='30' y2='39'/>
    <!-- Top pentagon to right pentagon -->
    <line x1='56' y1='27' x2='70' y2='39'/>
    <!-- Left pentagon to bottom pentagon -->
    <line x1='32' y1='54' x2='44' y2='75'/>
    <!-- Right pentagon to bottom pentagon -->
    <line x1='68' y1='54' x2='56' y2='75'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Additional seam detail from center pentagon corners -->
  <g stroke='#b8a87a' stroke-width='1' fill='none' opacity='0.5'>
    <line x1='56' y1='48' x2='64' y2='54'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='48' x2='36' y2='54'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Specular highlight on ball -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='30' rx='12' ry='8' fill='white' opacity='0.35' transform='rotate(-20 38 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='28' rx='6' ry='4' fill='white' opacity='0.5' transform='rotate(-20 36 28)'/>

  <!-- Small shine dots -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='26' r='1.5' fill='white' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='36' r='1' fill='white' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Cute face on the ball -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='45' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='45' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='44' r='1.2' fill='white' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='1.2' fill='white' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M44 52 Q50 58 56 52' stroke='#2a1a4a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='50' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff9999' opacity='0.4'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='50' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff9999' opacity='0.4'/>
</svg>
